annotations.title: Find primes and subcontractors for a kind of work

description:
Who does a kind of work, for the last complete fiscal year: the primes (with their
    certifications), the subcontractors primes reported paying (FSRS subawards), and prime ->
    subcontractor pairs, the teaming and subcontracting leads. Give at least one of naics, psc
    or agency; state narrows to where the work is done.

agency.description: An agency by name or code, e.g. "Department of the Navy".
agency.title: Agency

psc.description: A product or service code (PSC), e.g. "S201" (custodial).
psc.title: Psc

state.description: A state the work is done in, two letters, e.g. "VA".
state.title: State
